description: Load this skill whenever you are planning, executing, or reviewing manual accessibility testing. Manual testing with real assistive technologies is essential — automated tools catch only ~30–40 % of WCAG issues. Absolutely always include keyboard-only testing and at least one screen reader test before marking a feature accessible. Under no circumstances skip forced colors mode testing for UI components.
